senses.gloss:
mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
To be gone, to be gone to or attained.
E.
गम, and तव्य aff.

m. (-न्तुः)
A traveller, a way-farer.
E.
गम to go, Uṇādi affix तुन्.

mfn. (-न्तुः-न्तुः-न्तु)
A goer, a traveller, one who goes or moves.
E.
गम to go, Uṇādi affix तु, and the radical vowel made long.

mfn. (-न्ता-न्त्री-न्तृ)
Who or what goes or moves.
E.
गम to go, तृच् aff.

f. (-न्त्री)
A cart or car drawn by oxen.
E.
गम to go, ष्ट्रन् affix, fem. affix ङीष्.

f. (-न्त्री)
A carriage drawn by oxen.
E.
गम to go, ष्ट्रन् affix, fem. do. ङीष्, and the pen. made long; also गन्त्रा.

m. (-थः)
A cart.
E.
गन्त्री a carriage drawn by oxen, and रथ a vehicle.

r. 10th cl. (गन्धयते)
1 To injure, to hurt or kill.
2 To move, to go.
3 To ask or beg.

m. (-न्धः)
1 Smell, odour.
2 A perfume, a fragrance or fragrant substance.
3 A diffusive fragrance.
4 Sulphur.
5 Connexion, relationship.
6 A neighbour.
7 A plant, (Morunga hyperanthera, &c.)
8 Pride, arrogance.
9 Small, diminutive, a little, a small quantity, &c.
10 Pounded Sandal.
f. (-न्धा)
The bud of the Champaca flower, (Michelia Champaca.)
n. (-न्धं)
Aloe-wood.
E.
गन्ध to hurt, to move, &c. affix अच्.

m. (-कः)
1 Sulphur.
2 The morunga tree, (M. hyperanthera, &c.) see शोभाञ्जन.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

f. (-का)
A female artisan, living in the house of another woman.
E.
गन्ध perfume, and कारिका who makes.

f. (-का)
The mother of VYĀSA.
E.
कन् added to the next.

f. (-ली)
The mother of the poet VYĀSA.
E.
गन्ध perfume, कल to make, affixes अण् and ङीप् having a strong scent.

n. (-ष्ठं)
A fragrant wood, as Sandal, aloewood, &c.
E.
गन्ध smell, and काष्ठ timber.

f. (-टी)
A kind of perfume, commonly Mura.
E.
गन्ध smell, &c. कुटी abode.

n. (-डः)
A fragrant grass.
E.
गन्ध, and खेड grass; also with कन् added गन्धखेडकं: see गन्धतृण.

m. (-जः)
An elephant of the best kind.
E.
गन्ध odour, गज an elephant.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Having the property of odour.
E.
गन्ध and गुण quality.

n. (-णं)
Smelling any odour.
E.
गन्ध, and घ्राण smelling.

f. (-का)
Musk.
E.
गन्ध fragrance, चेलि clothes, affix कन्; being used for scenting clothes.

n. (-तं)
The leaf of the Laurus cassia.
E.
गन्ध smell, and जात produced; fragrant.

f. (-ज्ञा)
The nose.
E.
गन्ध scent, and ज्ञा who knows.

n. (-र्य्यं)
A musical instrument, one of a loud sound used in battle: (a drum or trumpet.)
E.
गन्ध pride, and तूर्य्य a musical instrument.

n. (-णं)
A fragrant grass, (Andropogon schoenanthus.)
E.
गन्ध, and तृण grass.

f. (-त्वक्)
A sort of perfume, commonly Elavāluka.
E.
गन्ध and त्वच् skin, rind.

m. (-पः)
An elephant of the best class, supposed to emit a particular smell at all times.
E.
गन्ध, and द्विप an elephant.

f. (-लिः)
Musk, the fragrant secretion of the musk-deer.
E.
गन्ध fragrant, and धूलि dust.

n. (-नं)
1 Continued effort, perseverance.
2 Injury, hurting, killing.
3 Intimation, information.
4 Manifestation.
E.
गन्ध to hurt, to move, &c. affix ल्युट्.

m. (-लः)
The musk-rat of Bengal, (Sorex moschata.)
E.
गन्ध scented, and नकुल an ichneumon.

f. (-ली)
A plant, possibly the serpent Ophioxylon: see रास्ना.
E.
गन्ध smelling, and नाकुली the same plant.

m. (-मा)
A fragrant kind of basil.
E.
गन्ध fragrance, and नामन् a name.

f. (-ली)
The nose.
E.
गन्ध scent, and नाली a tubular canal.

f. (-या)
Double jasmin, (J. Zambac floribus multiplicatis.)
E.
गन्ध smell, and निलय a house.

m. (-त्रः)
A white sort of basil, (Ocymum gratissimum): see श्वेतपर्णास.
f. (-त्री)
1 A sort of zedoary.
(-त्रा)
Ajwaen, (Ligusticam ajwaen.)
2 Another plant, (Physalis flexuosa.)
E.
गन्ध, and पत्र a leaf.

f. (-का)
Turmeric.
E.
गन्ध small, पलाश a leaf.

f. (-शी)
Zedoary, (Curcuma zerumbet.)
E.
गन्ध, and पलाश a leaf.

m. (-णः)
Sulphur.
E.
गन्ध smelling, and पाषाण a stone.

f. (-का)
The smell of incense, diffusive incense.
E.
गम्म smell, पिशाचिका female demon; imp-like, from its dark colour or cloudy nature; or attracting demons by its fragrance.

f. (-ता)
A species of zedoary.
E.
गन्ध, and पीत yellow.

m. (-ष्पः)
1 A kind of cane, (Calamus roatang.)
2 Another plant, (Alangium hexapetalum): see अङ्कोट.
3 Sebesten, (Cordia myxa.)
f. (-ष्पा)
1 The indigo plant.
2 Ganiyāri, (Premna spinosa, &c.) see गणिकारी.
n. (-ष्पं)
Flowers and Sandal presented together at seasons of worship.
E.
गन्ध smell, and पुष्प flower; having odoriferous flowers.

m. (-लः)
1 Elephant or wood apple: see कपित्थ.
2 The Bel, (Ægle crataeva.)
f. (-ला or -ली)
1 A plant bearing a fragrant seed: see प्रियङ्गु.
2 The gum olibanum tree.
f. (-ली)
The blossom of the Champaca: see चम्पक.
E.
गन्ध smell, and फल a fruit.

m. (-न्धुः)
The mango tree.
E.
गन्ध a smell, and बन्धु a friend.

f. (-द्रा)
A creeper commonly Gandhabhādali or Ghandali, (Poederia fetida?)
E.
गन्ध smell, and भद्र auspicious.

m. (-ण्डः)
A tree, (Hibiscus populneoides): see गर्द्धभाण्ड.

f. (-सी)
A kind of Indian spikenard: see जटामांसी.

f. (-ता)
The earth.
E.
गन्ध scent, and मातृ the mother; the property of fragrance residing in the earth or earthy atoms.

mn. (-नः-नं)
The name of a particular mountain, forming the division between Ilāvṛtta and Bhadrāśva or to the east of Meru.
m. (-नः)
1 A large black bee.
2 Sulphur.
3 The name of one of the monkey chiefs.
f. (-नी)
Spirituous liquor; also in some books read गन्धमादिनी.
E.
गन्ध smell, मद to inebriate in the causal form, and ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि)
Strong scented, of intoxicating odour.
f. (-नी)
1 Lac.
2 A sort of perfume.
3 Wine or spirituous liquor.
E.
गन्ध, and मादिन् what intoxicates.

m. (-रः)
The civet-cat.
E.
गन्ध smell, and मार्जार a cat.

f. (-नी)
Murā, a perfume so called.
E.
गन्ध smell, माला a necklace, affixes इनि and ङीप्.

m. (-ण्डः)
A creeper, (Hibiscus populneoides); also गन्थभाण्ड.

m. (-लः)
A plant with a fragrant and tuberous root, one of the Scitaminea, (Alpinia galanga): see कुलञ्जन.
f. (-ला or -ली)
1 A species of Curcuma, (C. reclinata, Rox.)
2 The olibanum tree.
E.
गन्ध smell, and मूल a root, fem. affix टाप् or ङीष्; also with कन् affix गन्धमूलक.

m. (-कः)
A sort of Curcuma; also गन्धमूली: see the preceding.

mf. (-कः-का)
The musk-rat or shrew, (Sorex moschata); also in the fem. गन्धमृषी.

m. (-गः)
The civet-cat.
E.
गन्ध smell, and मृग a deer; the name also may be applied to the musk-deer.

n. (-नं)
Sulphur.
E.
गन्ध, and मोदन pleasing.

m. (-नः)
A bull.
E.
गन्ध smell, and मैथुन copulation.

f. (-नी)
The Champaca flower.
E.
गन्ध smell, and मोहिनी delighting.

m. (-सः)
Myrrh.
E.
गन्ध smell, and रस essence; also रसगन्ध.

n. (-जं)
1 Sandal.
2 Any sweet smelling flower.
f. (-जी)
1 A sort of perfume, commonly Nakhi: see नखी.
E.
गन्ध smell, and राज what excels, from राज to shine, affix अच्; fem. affix ङीष्.

m. (-र्ब्बः)
1 A Gandharba or celestial musician; these demigods inhabit INDRA'S heaven, and form the orchestra at all the banquets of the principal deities.
2 A horse.
3 A kind of deer; according to some authorities, the musk-deer.
4 The soul after death, and previous to its being born again, corresponding, in some respects, to the western notion of ghosts.
5 A singer in general.
6 The Koïl or black cuckoo.
7 The sun.
8 A sage, a pious man.
E.
गन्ध smell, injury, &c. अर्ब्ब to go, affix अच्, the अ final of गन्ध is rejected; the root is also sometimes written with the dental letter अर्व्व, when the compound will be गन्धर्व्व; the best authorities however write it with the final labial letter ब as above.

mfn. (-र्ब्बः-र्ब्बी-र्ब्बं-)
Relating or belonging to a Gandharba.
m. (-र्ब्बः)
A heavenly quirister: see गन्धर्ब्ब.
n. (-र्ब्बं)
1 Song, singing.
2 A form of marriage, that which requires only mutual and amorous agreement.
E.
गन्धर्ब्ब a Gandharba, and अण् aff.

f. (-द्या)
Music, dancing, &c.
E.
गन्धर्ब्ब, and विद्या science.

m. (-हः)
Marriage by mutual consent, without any ceremonies, allowable between persons of the second class.
E.
गन्धर्ब्ब, and विवाह marriage.

m. (-दः)
The science of music considered as a branch of the Sāma Veda.
E.
गन्धर्ब्ब, and वेद a Veda.

m. (-स्तः)
The castor-oil tree, (Palma christi or Ricinus communis.)
E.
गन्धर्ब्ब a deer, and हस्त hand or foot; the leaves being compared to the foot of the deer; also with कन् added गन्धर्ब्बहस्तक.

f. (-पा)
A fly or gnat.
E.
गन्ध smell, &c. लोलुप unsteady.

m. (-णिक्)
A perfumer, a dealer in perfumes.
E.
गन्ध, and वणिज a dealer.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Scented, smelling, odoriferous.
f. (-ती)
1 The earth.
2 The name of a city.
3 Wine or vinous liquor.
4 A kind of perfume: see मुरा.
5 The mother of VYĀSA.
6 A wild species of Ajväen: see यमानी.
E.
गन्ध smell, मतुप् poss. affix fem. ङीप्.

n. (-लं)
1 Cassia bark.
2 Sarsaparilla.
E.
गन्ध, and वल्कल bark.

f. (-री)
A plant; also सहदेवी.
E.
गन्ध smell, and वल्लर a pedicle, or with वल्ली the same, गन्धवल्ली.

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
Smelling, fragrant, &c.
m. (-हः)
The wind.
f. (-हा)
The nose.
E.
गन्ध smell, and वह what conveys, from वह to bear, &c., and अच् aff.

m. (-हः)
1 The wind.
2 A deer, the musk-deer.
f. (-हा)
The nose.
E.
गन्ध smell, वह to convey, and अण् aff.

m. (-लः)
Wheat.

m. (-क्षः)
The Śāl tree, (Shorea robusta.)
E.
गन्ध perfume, and वृक्ष a tree, yielding a fragrant resin.

n. (-लं)
A perfume, a fragrant berry: see कक्कोल.
E.
गन्ध smell, and व्याकुल disturbed.

f. (-टी)
A sort of Curcuma: see शटी.
E.
गन्ध smell, and शटी the same plant.

m. (-लिः)
A sweet smelling kind of rice.
E.
गन्ध, and शालि rice.

f. (-नी)
The musk-rat or shrew.
E.
गन्ध, and शुण्डिनी a rat; also गन्धाशुण्डिनी.

m. (-रः)
Musk.
E.
गन्ध, and शेखर chief, a principal perfume.

m. (-रः)
Sandal.
E.
गन्ध, and सार essence, the essence of perfume.

f. (-यी)
The musk shrew or small musk-rat.
E.
गन्ध smell, and सू to produce, affixes युक् and ङीप्; also sometimes read गन्धसुखी, from गन्ध and सुख pleasure.

n. (-मं)
The white esculent water lily.
E.
गन्ध smell, and सोम the moon; opening its petals at night.

f. (-का)
A female artisan working in another person's house.

m. (-खुः)
A musk-rat.
E.
गन्ध smell, and आखु a rat: see गन्धसूयी, &c.

m. (-वः)
A vender of perfumes.
E.
गन्ध, and आजीव who gets a livelihood.

m. (-ढ्यः)
The orange tree.
f. (-ढ्या)
A plant: see गन्धाली.
E.
गन्ध, and आढ्य wealth, rich in odour.

n. (-णं)
Removing any smell.
E.
गन्ध, and अपकर्षण taking away.

f. (-ला)
A plant, commonly Jiyati, (Celtis orientalis.)

f. (-ली)
1 Gandhali or Gandbhadalīya, a plant, (Paederia fetida.)
2 A wasp: see गन्धोली.
E.
गन्ध smell, and आली a line, a quantity.

m. (-श्मा)
Sulphur.
E.
गन्ध smell, and अश्मन् a stone.

n. (-कं)
A class of eight fragrant articles used in worship, &c. as a Sandal, agallochum, camphor, saffron, valerian, and some fragrant grasses.
E.
गन्ध, and अष्टक eight collectively.

m. (-कः)
Sulphur.
E.
गन्ध smell, and ठक् affix; also गन्धक.

m. (-कः)
1 A scribe, a clerk.
2 A vender of perfumes, a perfumer.
3 A kind of worm, having a strong fetid smell.
E.
गन्ध smell, and ठञ् aff.

mfn. (-न्धी-न्धिनी-न्धि)
Smelling, odoriferous.
m. (-न्धी)
1 A bug; also the flying bug.
2 A tree, (Xanthophyllum virens.)
f. (-नी)
A kind of perfume: see Mura.
E.
गन्ध smelling, इनि poss. aff.

m. (-तुः)
The civet-cat.
E.
गन्ध smell, and ओतु a cat; also गन्धौतु.

f. (-मा)
Spirituous or vinous liquor.
E.
गन्ध odour, and उत्तम excellent.

m. (-वी)
A perfumer.
E.
गन्ध, and उपजीविन् who lives by.

f. (-लिः or -ली)
A kind of cucumber, (C. reclinata, Rox.)
(-ली)
1 A wasp.
2 A fragrant grass, (Cyperus rotundus.)
E.
गन्ध to smell or injure, ओलच affix, इन् or ङीष् fem. aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Singing, song in general, or a song.
2 Sound.
E.
गै to sing, affix ल्युट्.

f. (-नी)
Orris root.
E.
गान song, इनि and ङीप् affixes; supposed to be of use in clearing the voice.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Musical.
E.
गान and छ aff.

f. (-नी)
1 The river Ganges, or the goddess GAṄGĀ.
2 The mother of AKRŪRA.
E.
गो paradise, in the accusative case, द who gives, इनि, and ङीप् affs.

m. (-तः)
1 A name of BHĪṢMA, &c.
2 AKRŪRA.
E.
गान्दिनी GAṄGĀ, and सुत a son: see गङ्गासुत.

m. (-रः)
1 One of the seven primary notes of music.
2 Minium or red lead.
3 A country, (Kandahar, between the north of India and Persia.)
n. (-रं)
Gum myrrh.
f. (-री)
1 The wife of DHṚTARĀṢṬRA, mother of DURYODHANA.
2 One of the tutelary female deities of the Jainas.
3 A plant, (Hedysarum alhagi.)
4 Prickly nightshade.
E.
गान्ध the aggregate of गन्ध smell, &c. ऋ to go, and अण् affix; the note being said to be produced by pure and fragrant breath, &c.

m. (-यः)
A name of DURYODHANA, the son of DHṚTARĀṢṬRA.
E.
गान्धारी the name of the mother of this chief, and ढक् aff.
